<page>
Harbor Point Mutual Auto Insurance
Bodily Injury Unit
Claim Notes
Claim number:
C-1163
Claimant:
Katherine Cline
Adjuster:
Christopher Wong
November 8, 2024
Claim opened for a low-speed collision in a parking lot involving the insured's vehicle and a second vehicle. The
claimant reports a head injury diagnosed as a concussion and says they are not represented by an attorney.
December 19, 2024
Reviewed the policy file and confirmed the driver of the insured vehicle is named on the policy and coverage was in
force at the time of loss.
January 2, 2025
Obtained the police report, which places the claimant inside the vehicle at the time of the collision. Witness
statements on file describe the accident the same way the claimant did.
January 21, 2025
Photos from the scene and the other driver's statement both confirm the collision happened as described. The
damgae visible on the vehicle matches the impact reported.
February 3, 2025
Spoke with the claimant by phone. They gave the same account of the collision that was recorded at intake, with no
changes in the sequence of events.
March 24, 2025
Inspected the vehicle and found no earlier damage in the affected areas. Nothing in the file suggests any damage
predates the start of coverage.
March 26, 2025
Asked the claimant about any prior head or neck injuries. No earlier injury to the same body area is known from the
information provided so far.
April 6, 2025
Medical records show treatment for the concussion followed a uusal course, with visits tapering off as the claimant
improved. Whether the injury came from this crash has not yet been established and will need further medical review.
April 10, 2025
Second call with the claimant to check on symptoms and recovery. They repeated the same account of the accident
and said they are feeling better.
May 26, 2025
Requested updated treatment notes and a physician's statement to clarify the link between the collision and the
diagnosis. Awaiting response.
May 28, 2025
Reviewed the full file. Liability and vehicle damage are consistent with the reported loss. The bodily injury portion
stays open pending the medical review.
</page>

List the facts written on this page. Copy each value exactly as it is written: same spelling,
punctuation and date format. Do not add anything that is not on this page. Use "" for a missing value.

Person "role" must be one of: claimant, attorney, defense_attorney, expert, doctor, officer, adjuster, witness, other.
  claimant = the person who made the claim (also called patient, plaintiff, client, customer,
  or the driver who reported it). attorney = a lawyer for the claimant or plaintiff.
  defense_attorney = a lawyer for the insurance company or defendant.
Organization "type" must be one of: repair_shop, clinic, law_firm, court, insurer, police, other.
"policy_numbers" = only values labeled as a policy number. A claim number is not a policy number.
"street" and "city" = the person's own home address, only if the page gives it. Never use the
address of a clinic, shop, firm or court for a person.
"loss_dates" = only a date that the page clearly gives as the date of the accident, crash, loss or
injury. Do not list the date of a note, letter, report, visit, statement, filing or signature.
"words_before" = the words written on the page directly before that date, copied exactly, that say
it is the loss date. Examples: "Date of loss:", "Crash date:", "Date of injury:", "the collision on".
